title: Seeking Serenity
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘‘Seeking Serenity” a Luxury 8 Bedroom, 8 Full & 2 Half Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 26 guests, this home offers a private pool & spa, Gulf views, 6 complimentary bikes & a 6-seater golf cart.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Sleeps 26 • Private resort style pool and spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) • Summer Kitchen & Firepit • Elevator • Multiple Balconies with Gulf Views • 3 Stories with Rooftop Terrace • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Parking for 6 Vehicles SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 26) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 12) • Bedroom 1: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 2: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 3: Bunk Room (sleeps 8) Two Twin over Twin Bunk Beds + One Queen Over Queen Bunk and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 2) • Bedroom 4: Primary Guest Suite (sleeps 2): King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Walk-in Glass/Tile Shower & Modern Soaking Tub THIRD FLOOR (Sleeps 12) • Bedroom 5: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 6: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 7: Primary Guest Suite (sleeps 2): King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Walk-in Glass/Tile Shower & Modern Soaking Tub • Bedroom 8: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed with Shared Bathroom with Single Vanity & Glass/Tile Shower • Bunk Area (Sleeps 4) with Two Twin over Twin Bunk Beds and Shared Bathroom with Single Vanity & Glass/Tile Shower DESCRIPTION: Welcome to your dream vacation retreat in Dune Allen Beach— ‘Seeking Serenity’ is an exquisite 8-bedroom, 8-full-bath, 2-half-bath home designed for relaxation, luxury, and playful moments for all generations. With modern finishes, contemporary design, and thoughtful details, this expansive property offers the ultimate 30A experience. First Floor: A Welcoming Oasis Begin your escape in the spacious media room with a built-in bar, sink, mini fridge, and ice maker, offering the perfect space to unwind or entertain. Step into the outdoor oasis, featuring a private heated pool and spa, surrounded by four sun loungers, a firepit, and lush fenced greenery. Three serene guest suites are situated on the first floor; two king rooms with ensuite baths and a whimsical bunk room—provide comfort and privacy. Additional conveniences include a mudroom leading to the garage, an elevator to all three floors, and a well-equipped laundry room. Second Floor: An Elevated Living Experience: The heart of the home invites you to gather, connect, and unwind in style. The main living area is a stunning open-concept space where elegance meets functionality. The kitchen, a chef’s paradise, boasts a large island with seating for 7, state-of-the-art Thermador appliances, and a wet bar complete with a wine fridge and ice machine—perfect for preparing everything from morning coffee to evening cocktails. The adjacent dining area seats 10, offering the perfect setting for family meals and celebrations. Just beyond, the living room welcomes you with plush sofas, modern armchairs, and a cozy fireplace, creating a space where stories and laughter flow effortlessly. Step out onto the balcony to enjoy al fresco dining or relax in the comfortable seating area overlooking the sparkling pool. A serene king guest suite with an ensuite bath and a convenient half bath complete this inviting floor. Third Floor: Entertainment and Serenity: This level boasts a second media room with a large sectional and access to a balcony with breathtaking views. A wet/coffee bar adds convenience for morning coffee or evening drinks. Five king suites, including the primary king suite, feature spa-like ensuite baths, while a playful bunk area accommodates younger guests. A second laundry room ensures effortless convenience. Rooftop Terrace: Panoramic Bliss Soak in sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico and the rare coastal dune lake, Oyster Lake, from the rooftop terrace. Lounge on four sun loungers, enjoy meals at the al fresco dining table, or sip cocktails at the wet bar while watching the sunset. Outdoor Area: A Coastal Paradise The fenced backyard is an entertainer’s dream. Dive into the heated pool and spa, fire up the summer kitchen’s grilling station, or gather around the firepit under the stars. A screened porch offers shaded relaxation with additional dining and seating areas. The Perfect Blend of Style and Comfort This luxurious beach escape balances modern elegance with playful interiors that cater to all generations. Whether lounging poolside, savoring panoramic rooftop views, or creating lifelong memories in its inviting spaces, this home ensures every guest’s stay is nothing short of extraordinary. LAYOUT FIRST FLOOR: • Media Room & Bar Area with Sink, Mini Fridge & Ice Maker • Access to the Outdoor Oasis • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bath • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bath • Bunk Room with Ensuite Bathroom • Elevator • Mud Room Leading to Garage • Laundry Room SECOND FLOOR: • Main Living Space • Kitchen with large island that seats 7 • Thermador Appliances: range with dual oven, oversized fridge, dishwasher & convection microwave • Wet bar with Sink, Wine Fridge & Ice Machine • Dining Room table seats 10 • Living Room with Fireplace, Two Plush Sofas and 2 Modern Armchairs plus additional bench seating • Half Bath • Access to Balcony Overlooking Pool with Al Fresco Dining and Seating Area • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bathroom THIRD FLOOR: • Media Room with Large Sectional & Access to Balcony with Seating • Wet/Coffee Bar with Sink & Wine Fridge • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bath • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bath • Primary King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bath • King Guest Suite with Shared Bath • Bunk Area with Two Twin Over Twin Bunks with Shared Bath • Access to Rooftop Terrace • Extra Laundry Facilities ROOFTOP TERRACE: • Stunning Gulf and Coastal Dune Lake Views • Large Sectional and Al Fresco Dining Table • Wet Bar with TV, Sink, Mini Fridge & Ice Machine • Four Sun Loungers OUTDOOR AREA: • Private Heated Pool and Spa with 4 Sun Loungers & Outdoor Shower • Screened Porch with Al Fresco Dining for 6, Additional Seating Area & TV • Summer Kitchen with Grilling Station, Bar Seating, Fridge & Ice Maker • Fenced in Backyard with Green Space and Firepit
